note: THE DIAL for what https://tensorboard.g5d.io shows. `python -m main.tb_curate --apply`
rebuilds <repo>/tb_curated/ as one symlink per entry (<run> -> models/<run>/tb), and the
TensorBoard user service is pointed at that directory. Every LIVE run is unioned in
automatically (detected from `ps`), so the arm training right now always appears without
being listed here — add it here when it finishes and is worth keeping.
Editing this file is enough: TensorBoard rescans its logdir, so no restart is needed after
an --apply. Removing an entry removes only a symlink; models/ is never touched.
Seeded 2026-09-06 from `python -m main.lineage`. The archive holds 217 runs with a tb/;
this list is the long lines the owner reads, not the ablation arms that fork off them.
